values.meaning: Passive lightning bolt magic damage per stack
values.binNote: PassiveDamage's calc uses a literal 0.02 coefficient for max mana, matching the wiki's 2%; the separate data value PassiveManaRatio=0.05 is not read by this calculation and is listed unused.

values.meaning: Time between passive stack detonations (zap interval)
values.quote: one stack is consumed every 1 second to strike them with lightning

mechanics.claim: While Static Field is off cooldown, Blitzcrank's basic attacks apply a stack to the target on-hit, which does not require the attack to deal damage.
mechanics.quote: Blitzcrank's attacks do not have to deal damage to apply the mark.

mechanics.claim: One stack is consumed every 1 second dealing magic damage to the target, as a separate spell damage instance.
mechanics.quote: one stack is consumed every 1 second to strike them with lightning, dealing {{as|magic damage}} each time.

mechanics.claim: The lightning bolt ticks are spell damage while the active detonation is area damage.
mechanics.quote: The lightning bolts deal {{tip|spell damage}} while the static field applies {{tip|area damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The active detonation destroys shields on all nearby enemies (except monsters) before dealing damage, even if blocked by a spell shield.
mechanics.quote: Even if ''Static Field'' is blocked by a {{tip|spell shield}}, it will still destroy any existing damage {{tip|shield|shields}} on the target.
